defmodule LdapDriver.CircuitBreaker do
  use GenServer

  @failure_threshold 5
  @reset_timeout 30_000

  defstruct state: :closed, failure_count: 0, last_failure: nil

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %__MODULE__{}, opts)
  end

  def init(state), do: {:ok, state}

  def call(pid, fun) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:execute, fun})
  end

  def handle_call({:execute, fun}, _from, %{state: :open, last_failure: last} = state) do
    if System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - last > @reset_timeout do
      execute_with_breaker(fun, %{state | state: :half_open})
    else
      {:reply, {:error, :circuit_open}, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:execute, fun}, _from, state) do
    execute_with_breaker(fun, state)
  end

  defp execute_with_breaker(fun, state) do
    case fun.() do
      {:ok, result} ->
        {:reply, {:ok, result}, %{state | state: :closed, failure_count: 0}}
      {:error, reason} ->
        new_count = state.failure_count + 1
        new_state = if new_count >= @failure_threshold do
          %{state | state: :open, failure_count: new_count, last_failure: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)}
        else
          %{state | failure_count: new_count}
        end
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, new_state}
    end
  end
end

defmodule LdapDriver.QueryBuilder do
  @moduledoc """
  Builds LDAP filter expressions with proper escaping.
  Supports compound filters and attribute queries.
  """

  @special_chars [?\\, ?*, ?(, ?), ?\0]

  def build_filter(:and, filters) when is_list(filters) do
    joined = Enum.map(filters, &wrap_filter/1) |> Enum.join()
    "(&#{joined})"
  end

  def build_filter(:or, filters) when is_list(filters) do
    joined = Enum.map(filters, &wrap_filter/1) |> Enum.join()
    "(|#{joined})"
  end

  def build_filter(:eq, {attr, value}) when is_binary(attr) and is_binary(value) do
    "(#{sanitize_attr(attr)}=#{escape_value(value)})"
  end

  def build_filter(:present, attr) when is_binary(attr) do
    "(#{sanitize_attr(attr)}=*)"
  end

  def build_filter(:substring, {attr, initial, any_parts, final}) do
    parts = [
      if(initial, do: escape_value(initial), else: ""),
      "*",
      Enum.map(any_parts || [], &escape_value/1) |> Enum.join("*"),
      "*",
      if(final, do: escape_value(final), else: "")
    ] |> Enum.join()
    "(#{sanitize_attr(attr)}=#{parts})"
  end

  defp wrap_filter(filter) when is_binary(filter), do: filter

  defp sanitize_attr(attr) do
    # Only allow alphanumeric, hyphen, period for attribute names
    if Regex.match?(~r/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9\-\.]*$/, attr) do
      attr
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid attribute name: #{attr}"
    end
  end

  def escape_value(value) when is_binary(value) do
    value
    |> String.to_charlist()
    |> Enum.map(&escape_char/1)
    |> IO.iodata_to_binary()
  end

  defp escape_char(char) when char in @special_chars do
    "\\" <> String.pad_leading(Integer.to_string(char, 16), 2, "0")
  end
  defp escape_char(char), do: <<char::utf8>>
end

defmodule LdapDriver.Connection do
  @moduledoc """
  LDAP connection pool with circuit breaker integration.
  Provides search, bind, and modify operations.
  """

  alias LdapDriver.{CircuitBreaker, QueryBuilder}

  defstruct [:host, :port, :base_dn, :breaker_pid, :conn]

  def connect(opts) do
    {:ok, breaker} = CircuitBreaker.start_link()
    %__MODULE__{
      host: Keyword.fetch!(opts, :host),
      port: Keyword.get(opts, :port, 389),
      base_dn: Keyword.fetch!(opts, :base_dn),
      breaker_pid: breaker
    }
  end

  def search(%__MODULE__{} = conn, filter, opts \\ []) do
    scope = Keyword.get(opts, :scope, :subtree)
    attrs = Keyword.get(opts, :attributes, [])
    base = Keyword.get(opts, :base, conn.base_dn)

    CircuitBreaker.call(conn.breaker_pid, fn ->
      do_search(conn, base, filter, scope, attrs)
    end)
  end

  def find_user(%__MODULE__{} = conn, username, opts \\ []) do
    auth_attr = Keyword.get(opts, :auth_attr, "uid")
    extra_filter = Keyword.get(opts, :extra_filter, nil)

    user_filter = QueryBuilder.build_filter(:eq, {auth_attr, username})

    final_filter = if extra_filter do
      compose_filters(user_filter, extra_filter)
    else
      user_filter
    end

    search(conn, final_filter, opts)
  end

  def authenticate(%__MODULE__{} = conn, username, password, opts \\ []) do
    case find_user(conn, username, opts) do
      {:ok, [entry | _]} ->
        dn = entry_dn(entry)
        bind(conn, dn, password)
      {:ok, []} ->
        {:error, :not_found}
      error ->
        error
    end
  end

  # Composes two filter strings. If extra_filter is a pre-built string
  # from a trusted configuration source, it's combined directly.
  # This enables dynamic filter composition from config-driven rules.
  defp compose_filters(primary, extra) when is_binary(primary) and is_binary(extra) do
    "(&#{primary}#{extra})"
  end

  defp do_search(conn, base, filter, scope, attrs) do
    # Simulated LDAP search - in production this calls :eldap
    case :eldap.search(conn.conn, [
      {:base, String.to_charlist(base)},
      {:filter, {:raw, String.to_charlist(filter)}},
      {:scope, scope},
      {:attributes, Enum.map(attrs, &String.to_charlist/1)}
    ]) do
      {:ok, result} -> {:ok, result}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp bind(conn, dn, password) do
    CircuitBreaker.call(conn.breaker_pid, fn ->
      case :eldap.simple_bind(conn.conn, String.to_charlist(dn), String.to_charlist(password)) do
        :ok -> {:ok, :authenticated}
        error -> error
      end
    end)
  end

  defp entry_dn(entry), do: elem(entry, 1)
end

defmodule LdapDriver.UserService do
  @moduledoc """
  High-level user operations built on the LDAP connection driver.
  """

  alias LdapDriver.{Connection, QueryBuilder}

  def login(conn, params) do
    username = Map.fetch!(params, "username")
    password = Map.fetch!(params, "password")
    group = Map.get(params, "required_group")

    opts = build_login_opts(group)
    Connection.authenticate(conn, username, password, opts)
  end

  defp build_login_opts(nil), do: []
  defp build_login_opts(group) do
    # Group filter is built using the safe QueryBuilder escaping
    group_dn = "cn=#{group},ou=groups,dc=example,dc=com"
    group_filter = QueryBuilder.build_filter(:eq, {"memberOf", group_dn})
    [extra_filter: group_filter]
  end
end
